facts.fact: The General Application and Implementation Directive 2025 is issued under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, which the document treats as the law in force.

The General Application and Implementation Directive 2025, issued under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, has been in force since September 2025 and requires Ultra-High and Extra-High category controllers and processors of major importance to submit annual Compliance Audit Returns to the NDPC.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission is acting under the Act: it receives audit returns, licenses Data Protection Compliance Organisations and issued compliance notices.

In February 2026 the NDPC named 649 higher-education institutions in a notice requiring them to produce compliance documentation within 21 days, and in 2025 it issued compliance notices seeking evidence of audit returns, data protection officers and registrations.
